baseten.note: Muse Spark Open (open weights) on Baseten: eligible for the open-weight prize.

meta.note: Hosted Muse Spark on the Meta Model API.

browser.note: attach: 'autoConnect' = your running Chrome (enable chrome://inspect/#remote-debugging once, Chrome 144+); 'browserUrl' = Chrome started with --remote-debugging-port.

screenshot.note: After each of these tool calls the agent sends the UI a screenshot (never shown to the model). It is awaited with a timeout and never fails the run. The camera button in the UI takes one on demand.

telemetry.note: JSONL log of every model call, tool call, attach and error. dir is relative to server/.

memory.note: SOUL.md and MEMORY.md: markdown documents the agent and the user can both edit. budgetTokens caps what is put in the prompt.

playbooks.note: How the agent solved tasks before, found again by meaning with a small local embedding model (see ../README.md). Only short pointers enter the prompt, and only on a strong match.

audio.note: Speech to text with Muse Voice Transcribe (needs META_MODEL_API_KEY, whichever model provider is used). The chat box records, the server converts with ffmpeg and transcribes.

staleSnapshots.note: Page snapshots are large and only the latest is usable (element ids belong to it). Older ones are replaced by this placeholder in what the model sees (the saved conversation keeps them). Switch off with AGENT_CLEAR_OLD_SNAPSHOTS=0 to compare token use.
staleSnapshots.placeholder: [older page snapshot removed to save tokens: the page may have changed. Call take_snapshot for a current view.]
